name: skeleton
description: A loading placeholder that pulses while content is fetching. Code-only — no published Figma component. Compose multiple instances to mirror the real content layout.

figmaReference.note: Figma page contains reference layout frames (Card + Image, Image + Text, Text, List, Simple text, Widget) for design documentation only. Not a published component set.

tokens.note: Token is applied via Tailwind class bg-muted — not bound directly in Figma. Uses background (not surface) because skeleton sits on the page canvas.

composition.sizing: controlled entirely by className — pass h-*, w-*, rounded-* as needed

accessibility.screenReader: Mark the loading container with aria-busy="true" while skeleton is shown. Do not add aria-label to individual Skeleton elements.
accessibility.reducedMotion: animate-pulse respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce via Tailwind — animation stops automatically

constraints: Code-only — do not publish as a Figma component set.
Background must use bg-muted (color/background/muted) — not color/surface/muted.
Match skeleton dimensions to the real content layout to avoid layout shift on load.
Wrap loading region in aria-busy='true' on the parent container.
Do not use skeleton for infinite scroll bottoms — use an indeterminate spinner instead.
Remove skeleton immediately when data is available — do not leave it animating.

useCases: Replacing a card grid while the list of items loads from an API
Showing placeholder rows in a table before row data has been fetched
Holding the layout of a user profile (avatar + name + bio) while the profile data resolves
Mimicking a form layout while the form's default values load from the server
Preserving the visual structure of a dashboard widget while its metrics are fetching
Replacing a full-page content area during initial navigation to prevent layout shift

comparedTo.situation: Data has loaded and there is simply nothing to show (zero items)
comparedTo.notInstead: skeleton (skeleton signals content is coming; empty signals there is nothing to come)

comparedTo.situation: A specific operation has a known percentage of completion
comparedTo.notInstead: skeleton (progress communicates deterministic advancement; skeleton is for unknown-duration loads)

comparedTo.situation: A single button or form action is in a loading state
comparedTo.notInstead: skeleton (skeleton replaces content layout, not interactive controls)

notes: 2026-05-28: Documented as code-only. shadcn skeleton is a single div with animate-pulse + bg-muted — no component tokens to manage. Figma page left as reference layout documentation.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
